words.defn_en: sprightly:

sentences.en: He walked down the street with a ______ step, whistling a tune.
sentences.zh: 他邁著輕快活潑的步伐走在街上,吹著口哨。

sentences.en: She wore a ______ hat tilted slightly to one side.
sentences.zh: 她戴著一頂略微歪斜、看起來輕鬆俏皮的帽子。

words.defn_en: native:

sentences.en: The museum features artwork created by ______ artists of the region.
sentences.zh: 這座博物館展出該地區原住民藝術家創作的作品。

sentences.en: Corn is ______ to the Americas and was later introduced to other continents.
sentences.zh: 玉米原產於美洲,後來才被引進其他大陸。

words.defn_en: descendants, offspring

sentences.en: The old oak tree has produced countless ______ scattered throughout the forest.
sentences.zh: 這棵老橡樹已經產下無數散布在森林各處的後代。

sentences.en: The king hoped his ______ would rule the kingdom for generations to come.
sentences.zh: 國王希望他的後代子孫能世世代代統治這個王國。

words.defn_en: dissimilar:

sentences.en: The classroom was made up of a ______ mix of students from many countries.
sentences.zh: 這間教室由來自許多國家、背景各異的學生組成。

sentences.en: The rock sample contained a ______ mixture of minerals.
sentences.zh: 這塊岩石標本含有成分各異的礦物混合物。

words.defn_en: sympathetic, agreeable:

sentences.en: The staff at the small inn were warm and ______.
sentences.zh: 這家小旅館的員工既熱情又意氣相投。

sentences.en: She found her new coworkers to be friendly and ______.
sentences.zh: 她發現新同事既友善又合得來。

words.defn_en: to abuse, slander:

sentences.en: The tabloids tried to ______ the actor with baseless rumors.
sentences.zh: 這些八卦小報試圖用毫無根據的謠言中傷這位演員。

sentences.en: He accused his rival of trying to ______ his reputation.
sentences.zh: 他指控對手企圖詆毀他的名聲。

words.defn_en: certain form or style in painting or literature:

sentences.en: Science fiction is her favorite literary ______.
sentences.zh: 科幻小說是她最喜歡的文學類型。

sentences.en: The director is known for blending different film ______s in one movie.
sentences.zh: 這位導演以在同一部電影中融合不同類型而聞名。

words.defn_en: same, uniform:

sentences.en: The neighborhood was once fairly ______ but has since become more diverse.
sentences.zh: 這一帶社區曾經相當單一同質,但如今已變得更加多元。

sentences.en: The company sought a more ______ approach to branding across regions.
sentences.zh: 這家公司希望在各地區採取更加一致統一的品牌策略。

words.defn_en: planned destruction of an entire people:

sentences.en: The tribunal was established to prosecute those responsible for the ______.
sentences.zh: 設立這個法庭是為了起訴應為這起種族滅絕負責的人。

sentences.en: Historians continue to study the causes and aftermath of the ______.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家持續研究這場種族滅絕的成因與後續影響。

words.defn_en: very carefully
words.root_note: gensor (delicate, Old French; no clear classical root)

sentences.en: She ______ stepped over the broken glass on the floor.
sentences.zh: 她小心翼翼地跨過地板上的碎玻璃。

sentences.en: He ______ picked up the injured bird and placed it in a box.
sentences.zh: 他小心翼翼地抱起這隻受傷的鳥,把牠放進箱子裡。

words.defn_en: very clever or inventive

sentences.en: The engineer came up with an ______ solution to the water shortage.
sentences.zh: 這位工程師針對缺水問題提出了一個巧妙的解決方案。

sentences.en: Her ______ design won first prize at the science fair.
sentences.zh: 她巧妙的設計在科展中贏得了首獎。

words.defn_en: favorable, not threatening, mild:

sentences.en: The doctor was relieved to find the tumor was ______.
sentences.zh: 醫生鬆了一口氣,發現這顆腫瘤是良性的。

sentences.en: Her ______ smile put the nervous new employee at ease.
sentences.zh: 她溫和的微笑讓這位緊張的新員工放鬆了下來。

words.defn_en: present at birth but not necessarily hereditary:

sentences.en: The infant was diagnosed with a rare ______ heart defect.
sentences.zh: 這名嬰兒被診斷出患有一種罕見的先天性心臟缺陷。

sentences.en: Doctors monitored the baby closely for any ______ conditions.
sentences.zh: 醫生密切觀察這名嬰兒是否有任何先天性病症。

words.defn_en: the state of having declined in moral or physical standards:

sentences.en: The critic decried the moral ______ of modern society.
sentences.zh: 這位評論家譴責現代社會的道德墮落。

sentences.en: The empire's final years were marked by cultural ______ .
sentences.zh: 這個帝國的末年以文化衰退墮落為特徵。

words.defn_en: to decline in quality or morals; morally corrupt:

sentences.en: The debate quickly ______ d into shouting.
sentences.zh: 這場辯論很快就退化成了互相叫囂。

sentences.en: The novel's ______ characters live only for pleasure.
sentences.zh: 這本小說中墮落的角色只為享樂而活。

words.defn_en: originating from within an organism or system:

sentences.en: The body produces ______ hormones to regulate stress.
sentences.zh: 人體會產生內源性荷爾蒙來調節壓力。

sentences.en: Economists debated whether the growth was ______ or driven by trade.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家爭論這次成長是內生的,還是由貿易所驅動的。

words.defn_en: to bring about, create, generate:

sentences.en: The new policy is likely to ______ significant public debate.
sentences.zh: 這項新政策很可能引發重大的公眾辯論。

sentences.en: Years of shared hardship helped ______ a deep trust among the crew.
sentences.zh: 多年共同經歷的困境,幫助這群船員之間培養出深厚的信任。

words.defn_en: originating from outside a system or organism:

sentences.en: Researchers studied the effects of ______ hormones on growth.
sentences.zh: 研究人員研究了外源性荷爾蒙對生長的影響。

sentences.en: The recession was caused by an ______ shock to the economy.
sentences.zh: 這場經濟衰退是由一次外部經濟衝擊所引起的。

words.defn_en: an account of a family's or person's descent from an ancestor:

sentences.en: She traced her ______ back six generations using old church records.
sentences.zh: 她利用古老的教堂紀錄,將她的家譜追溯回六代之前。

sentences.en: Researching family ______ has become a popular hobby.
sentences.zh: 研究家族系譜已經成為一項熱門的嗜好。

words.defn_en: to produce or bring into existence:

sentences.en: Solar panels ______ electricity from sunlight.
sentences.zh: 太陽能板能利用陽光產生電力。

sentences.en: The announcement began to ______ public interest.
sentences.zh: 這項宣布開始引起大眾的興趣。

words.defn_en: showing readiness to give freely; ample:

sentences.en: Her ______ donation funded the entire scholarship program.
sentences.zh: 她慷慨的捐款資助了整個獎學金計畫。

sentences.en: The restaurant serves ______ portions at every meal.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳每一餐都提供豐盛的份量。

words.defn_en: the origin or beginning of something:

sentences.en: The company's ______ traces back to a small garage workshop.
sentences.zh: 這家公司的起源可以追溯到一間小車庫工作室。

sentences.en: The idea's ______ came from a casual conversation.
sentences.zh: 這個想法的起源來自於一次隨意的談話。

words.defn_en: the study of heredity and inherited traits:

sentences.en: She majored in ______ to study inherited diseases.
sentences.zh: 她主修遺傳學,以研究遺傳性疾病。

sentences.en: Advances in ______ have led to new treatments for rare disorders.
sentences.zh: 遺傳學的進展帶來了針對罕見疾病的新療法。

words.defn_en: friendly, affable:

sentences.en: The ______ host made every guest feel instantly welcome.
sentences.zh: 這位和藹可親的主人讓每位賓客都立刻感到賓至如歸。

sentences.en: Despite his intimidating size, he had a ______ smile that put people at ease.
sentences.zh: 儘管體型嚇人,他親切的笑容卻讓人感到放鬆。

words.defn_en: polite, refined, or affectedly proper:
words.root_note: gentilis (of the same clan), from Latin

sentences.en: She grew up in a ______ household with strict manners.
sentences.zh: 她在一個講究禮儀、上流的家庭中長大。

sentences.en: His ______ manner masked a ruthless business sense.
sentences.zh: 他文雅的舉止掩蓋了他無情的商業手腕。

words.defn_en: the act of bending the knee, especially in worship:

sentences.en: The worshippers made a brief ______ before the altar.
sentences.zh: 信徒們在祭壇前做了一個簡短的屈膝禮。

sentences.en: A slight ______ is customary upon entering the chapel.
sentences.zh: 進入這座禮拜堂時,行個輕微的屈膝禮是習俗。

words.defn_en: authentic or real:

sentences.en: His apology seemed ______.
sentences.zh: 他的道歉聽起來相當真誠。

sentences.en: The store guarantees that every product is a ______ leather item.
sentences.zh: 這家商店保證每件產品都是真皮製品。

words.defn_en: to make uniform or similar throughout:

sentences.en: Globalization tends to ______ local cultures over time.
sentences.zh: 全球化往往會使當地文化隨著時間趨於同質化。

sentences.en: The dairy plant uses machines to ______ the milk.
sentences.zh: 這座乳品廠使用機器將牛奶均質化。

words.defn_en: of the same kind; uniform in composition:

sentences.en: The committee was surprisingly ______ in its opinions.
sentences.zh: 這個委員會的意見出人意料地一致。

sentences.en: The neighborhood was largely ______ in its architecture.
sentences.zh: 這個社區的建築風格大致上相當一致。

words.defn_en: caused by medical treatment or examination:
words.defn_zh: 醫源性的(由治療引起的)

sentences.en: The infection turned out to be ______ , caused by the surgery itself.
sentences.zh: 這場感染最終被證實是醫源性的,由手術本身所引起。

sentences.en: Doctors work to minimize ______ complications during treatment.
sentences.zh: 醫生致力於在治療過程中減少醫源性併發症。

words.defn_en: not devious; innocent and candid:

sentences.en: The child's ______ questions about death caught her parents off guard.
sentences.zh: 這個孩子率真地問起關於死亡的問題,讓父母措手不及。

sentences.en: His ______ honesty about his mistakes won over the skeptical committee.
sentences.zh: 他坦率承認自己的錯誤,贏得了原本存疑的委員會的信任。

words.defn_en: the practice of inheritance passing to the last-born child:

sentences.en: Under the old custom of ______ , the youngest son inherited the family farm.
sentences.zh: 在幼子繼承制的舊習俗下,家中最小的兒子繼承了家族的農場。

sentences.en: Historians study how ______ shaped inheritance patterns in certain rural regions.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家研究幼子繼承制如何塑造了某些鄉村地區的繼承模式。

words.defn_en: the right of the firstborn child to inherit the family estate:

sentences.en: Under ______ , the eldest son inherited the entire family fortune.
sentences.zh: 在長子繼承制之下,長子繼承了整個家族的財產。

sentences.en: The novel critiques the injustice of ______ toward younger siblings.
sentences.zh: 這本小說批判了長子繼承制對年幼手足所造成的不公。

words.defn_en: an ancestor or originator; a precursor:
words.root_note: progenitor (ancestor), from Latin pro- (forth) + gignere (to beget)

sentences.en: The scientist is considered a ______ of modern genetics.
sentences.zh: 這位科學家被視為現代遺傳學的先驅。

sentences.en: Historians traced the family's ______ s back to medieval nobility.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家將這個家族的祖先追溯到中世紀的貴族。

words.defn_en: unique; in a class of its own:
words.defn_zh: 獨一無二的;自成一格的
words.root_note: sui (of its own) + generis (kind), from Latin

sentences.en: Critics described her artistic style as truly ______ .
sentences.zh: 評論家形容她的藝術風格真正是獨一無二的。

sentences.en: The legal case was considered ______ , setting no broader precedent.
sentences.zh: 這起法律案件被認為自成一格,並未設下更廣泛的先例。

words.defn_en: a system of inheritance in which the youngest child inherits the estate:

sentences.en: Some historical cultures practiced ______ instead of favoring the eldest heir.
sentences.zh: 某些歷史文化實行幼子繼承制,而非偏袒長子繼承。

sentences.en: Under ______ , the family farm passed to the youngest son.
sentences.zh: 根據幼子繼承制,這座家族農場傳給了最年幼的兒子。
